title: Regioselectivity: adding HBr to propene
caption: HBr can add to propene two ways. The major product, 2-bromopropane, forms via the more stable secondary carbocation (Markovnikov's rule); 1-bromopropane, via a primary carbocation, is minor. The two products are position isomers.
alt: Propene with an arrow to 2-bromopropane (major) and 1-bromopropane (minor).
description: Major: 2-bromopropane, Br on the middle carbon.
Minor: 1-bromopropane, Br on the end carbon.
